payout_quote: $125 in extra cash could be yours for getting your friends to bring their number and sign up with Metro. You'll earn $25 per referral, up to $125 per year, and your friends will earn $25, too... Refer up to five (5) friends annually. $25 via virtual prepaid MasterCard, up to $125 annually. (Official Metro by T-Mobile referral page, crawled 2026-09-23)
timing: Reward issued after the friend's qualifying signup; $25 via virtual prepaid MasterCard per referral
eligibility: Existing Metro by T-Mobile customer; friend must be a new customer who brings (ports) their number and signs up via your referral
steps: Register for the Refer-a-Friend program on the Metro site
Invite friends via your referral link
Each friend ports their number and signs up with Metro
You get $25 per friend (virtual prepaid MasterCard), they get $25 too
Repeat up to 5 friends per year for up to $125
catches: Hard cap: 5 friends per year, $125 annual maximum per referrer
Your friend must port in their existing number - new numbers may not qualify
You must be an existing Metro customer; you can't refer before you're a customer
Reward is a virtual prepaid MasterCard, not cash - it's spendable but not a bank deposit
Your friend must complete a qualifying signup, not just click your link
biggest_catch: Capped at $125/year total - this is five referrals and done, not an ongoing income stream.

Only refer friends who genuinely want to switch to Metro and port their number; the reward needs a qualifying signup, not just a click.
